items.description: Promoted after exceeding goals, I brought RAG and LLMs to the team: I am building a multi-agent system to automate tier-1 support, aiming to reduce ticket volume and the IT team’s response time.

First promotion, earned by delivering under demanding deadlines. I advanced in data integration, with ETL pipelines and analytical reports for the coffee business, and started my first generative AI prototypes with RAG and LLMs.
